components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: var(--tap, 44px); padding: 11px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #087050); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #087050); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #065c42); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent-pressed, #054a35); } .ds-icon { width: 1em; height: 1em; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-icon { transform: translateX(3px); }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is presented the way Linear and Stripe present a product: a white page, large real screens set on quiet tinted stages, a single green that means "act here", and pill controls that answer a press. It is the category standard for a modern developer portfolio, executed straight; the polish is the point, not a concept laid over it. Shipped products carry the proof, so the system's job is to give real captures room, scale and a calm ground.

Density is generous. Sections sit 80 to 160px apart, copy columns stay near 34 to 38em, and depth comes from one tone step of cool grey rather than from lines or boxes. Dark ink bands (experiments, code, the contact close and footer) are the only change of ground, and they invert the same rules rather than introducing a second palette. Motion is short and strong-eased: things rise in once, controls compress on press, and nothing moves under reduced motion.

The confirmed rejections come from the chosen direction: no cream-and-serif editorial look, no dark gradient hero, no grid of uniform cards.
keyCharacteristics: White canvas, one cool grey tone step for panels, near-black ink, one green accent.
Mona Sans as the only text family, set tight and heavy (650) for headings; tabular figures where numbers align.
Every control is a pill at least 44px tall with scale(0.97) press feedback.
Real screenshots in browser and phone frames on 20px-rounded tinted stages, never in outlined boxes.
Shadows only where something floats over something else.
Dark ink bands for code and the close.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "act here" or "this is live": primary action, links, focus, selection, the Live dot. Nothing decorative is green.

rules.name: The Word-With-Colour Rule
rules.body: Status colour never stands alone. Green, rust and the Live dot always sit beside the word they qualify.

rules.name: The Tone-Step Rule
rules.body: Depth on the light ground comes from Stage Grey and Pressed Grey, not from borders. If a region needs separating, put it on the next tone step.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Mona Sans sets every word; the system monospace sets only code. No second display face.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase and no positive letter-spacing anywhere. Hierarchy comes from size and weight (400, 500, 600, 650), never from caps or tracking.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Columns of numbers and dates (ledger, timeline) use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is allowed only when an element overlaps or floats above other content. Panels, cards in flow, and buttons are flat.

rules.name: The Real-Table Rule
rules.body: A drawn 1px line appears only between rows of a real table (the ledger, the timeline, reconstruction tables) or inside a reconstructed interface that draws its own UI. No section dividers, no outlined panels.

dos: **Do** keep Ship Green to the primary action, links, focus, selection and the Live dot.
**Do** separate regions with a tone step (Stage Grey, then Pressed Grey) instead of a line.
**Do** make every control a pill at least 44px tall with scale(0.97) press feedback.
**Do** set real captures in browser or phone frames on 20px-rounded Stage Grey stages.
**Do** label anything not captured from a real screen with the warm illustrative chip.
**Do** set headings in Mona Sans at 650 with negative tracking (-0.015em to -0.04em).
**Do** use the strong ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) for entrances and responses, and drop movement under reduced motion.
**Do** pair every status colour with its word.
donts: **Don't** draw lines outside real tables and reconstructed interfaces: no section dividers, no outlined panels, no outline buttons.
**Don't** add a shadow to anything that doesn't float over other content.
**Don't** introduce a second type family, uppercase text or positive letter-spacing.
**Don't** place small labels or kickers above headings.
**Don't** use the cream-and-serif editorial look, a dark gradient hero, or a grid of uniform cards.
